title: FT — Identification of Residue Periodicities in Sequences

creators.name: Pasquier, Claude
creators.affiliation: Division of Cell Biology and Biophysics, Department of Biology, University of Athens, Greece (original work, 1998); Université Côte d'Azur, CNRS, I3S, Sophia Antipolis, France (modernised edition, 2026)

description: Modern browser-based re-implementation of the FT tool for the identification of residue periodicities in protein and nucleotide sequences, using a WebAssembly port of the original C FFT pipeline. Original method: Pasquier et al., Study of residue periodicities in sequences.
